menus.note: Wednesday to Sunday, plus service and VAT (++); two or three glasses of wine THB 1,200 or 1,700

alsoTry.name: The Wine Bar
alsoTry.note: The hotel's wine bar on the M floor, open for lunch and dinner Wednesday to Sunday; smart casual

bookingOpens: Online on TableCheck, ideally at least three hours ahead, or by phone or email (cannubi.dtbk@dusit.com). The restaurant then contacts guests to take a deposit of THB 2,000 a person.
cancellation: A deposit of THB 2,000 net a person is taken after booking. Tables are held for 15 minutes past the booking time.
dressCode: Elegant. Shorts, sandals and flip-flops are not allowed.
children: Children aged 10 and over may dine in the main dining room; younger children are seated in the second-floor dining rooms.
